description: Elevation at a point: Ground elevation at a coordinate from the USGS 3D Elevation Program point query service (free, no key). Source: USGS 3DEP EPQS. US coverage; a DEM sample, not a survey. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: elevation, units, resolution_m, raster_id.
name: x420_geo_elevation
